custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create two tracked parts for this test at a cost of $10.00 and a Sell Price of $20.00: part A with 0 in its only bin and part B with 4 in its only bin.
  • Add 2 of part A to a work order line while its bin holds 0, so part A's bin goes to -2.
  • Give parts A and B part numbers that start with the same text, so one search lists both.
  • Start on the Inventory Value report (Reports in the top bar, then Inventory Value under PARTS in the left menu), with the as-of date on today.

Setup

  1. Make part A: Click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill in: Description: ZZAUTOTEST PL C425661 PART A; Part Number: ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425661-A; Category: any one; Cost: 10.00; Sell Price: 20.00; Quantity (in the bin row): 0. Click Save.
  2. Make part B: Click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill in: Description: ZZAUTOTEST PL C425661 PART B; Part Number: ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425661-B; Category: any one; Cost: 10.00; Sell Price: 20.00; Quantity (in the bin row): 4. Click Save.
  3. Make work order 1: Click Work Orders in the top bar, then Create Work Order. Pick any Customer and any Asset. Click Save. In the New Line window that opens, type ZZAUTOTEST PL C425661 LINE 1 in Title and press Tab, pick any Labor Rate, tick Line Approved, then click Save & Close.
  4. Put part A on the line: In the line's Parts row click + Add Part. Type ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425661-A in Part number and pick the result that shows Inventory Qty. Type 2 in Qty *. Click Save.
  5. The part numbers above both start ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425661-.
